course_summary:
ISEN 614 | Advanced Quality Control | Fall 2026
Instructor: Jaesung Lee | j.lee@tamu.edu
Meets: Online
Grading: Three Exams [65%], In-class Exercise [15%], Homework [10%], Course Project [10%] — A: 90-100, B: 80-89.9, C: 70-79.9, D: 60-69.9, F: Below - 59.9
Topics: T2 Charts, PCA, ARL, Regression-based Risk Adjustment, Attribute Control Charts, Multivariate Statistics, discrete Distributions, Probability Distributions, Statistical Inference, Confidence Interval, Hypothesis Testing, Errors, Control Chart, linear regression, statistical process control, anomaly detection, change detection, root cause identification, data analysis tools, manufacturing quality control, medical error detection, quality control programs evaluation, quality control programs design, quality control programs maintenance, monitoring, real-life dataset handling, decision making, justification, knowledge broadening, literature reading, team formation, written report submission, basic principles, applications, concept understanding, concept employment, exploring avenues, Advanced Quality Control
Tools: Canvas, Matlab, R, Python, EXCEL, Minitab, TI 84 Plus, TI 89, Nspire
Prerequisites: STAT 212, STAT 601, ISEN 350
